title: Integration of Insights View into Playwright Functional Tests
description: Verify that the Insights view can be properly integrated and enabled in Playwright functional test framework.
testDescription: This test verifies that Insights view can be successfully integrated into Playwright functional tests, similar to the existing implementation in Unit, Integration, and API tests.
prerequisites:
1. Playwright functional test framework is set up.
2. Access to the codebase where Insights view is already implemented for other test types.
3. Developer permissions to modify the Playwright configuration.
stepsToPerform:
1. Add the necessary Insights view imports to the Playwright test configuration file.
2. Configure the Insights view plugin in the Playwright setup.
3. Add initialization code in the global setup file.
4. Create a simple test that executes a basic UI interaction.
5. Run the test with Insights view enabled.
expectedResult:
1. The test executes successfully without errors.
2. The Insights view appears during or after test execution.
3. The Insights panel contains the correct test information and results.
4. The core test functionality is not affected by the Insights view integration.
testEnvironment: Development environment with latest Playwright version
testData: Basic UI test that performs simple interactions like clicking buttons or filling forms
bugDetectionPotential: High - This test would catch any fundamental integration issues between Insights view and Playwright functional tests

title: Data Population and Consistency in Insights View for Functional Tests
description: Verify that test execution data is properly captured and displayed in the Insights view for functional tests.
testDescription: This test ensures that all relevant functional test data (actions, assertions, screenshots, network requests, console logs) are correctly captured and displayed in the Insights view.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. A test suite with various UI interactions and assertions exists.
stepsToPerform:
1. Create a functional test that includes multiple UI interactions (clicks, form filling, navigation).
2. Add assertions for different elements on the page.
3. Include network request validations.
4. Trigger some console logs during test execution.
5. Run the test with Insights view enabled.
6. Examine the data displayed in the Insights view.
expectedResult:
1. All UI interactions are recorded and displayed chronologically in the Insights view.
2. Screenshots are captured at key steps and displayed in the Insights view.
3. Network requests triggered during test execution are visible in the Insights view.
4. Console logs are captured and displayed in the Insights view.
5. All test assertions and their results are correctly shown.
testData: Complex UI test with multiple interactions, assertions, and network requests
bugDetectionPotential: High - This test would catch issues with data capturing and display mechanisms

title: Performance Impact of Insights View on Functional Test Execution
description: Verify that enabling the Insights view does not significantly degrade the performance of functional test execution.
testDescription: This test measures and compares the performance (execution time, memory usage) of functional tests with and without the Insights view enabled.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. A substantial functional test suite exists that can be used for performance comparison.
stepsToPerform:
1. Run a functional test suite with Insights view disabled and record the execution time and memory usage.
2. Run the same functional test suite with Insights view enabled and record the execution time and memory usage.
3. Compare the results from both runs.
4. Run an extended test session (1+ hour) with Insights view enabled to check for memory leaks.
5. Monitor system resources during the extended test run.
expectedResult:
1. The performance difference between tests with and without Insights view should be minimal (less than 10% increase in execution time).
2. Memory usage should remain stable during extended test runs, with no significant increase over time.
3. No memory leaks are detected during extended test execution.
4. System resources (CPU, memory) usage remains within acceptable limits.
testEnvironment: Performance testing environment with monitoring tools
testData: Extensive functional test suite with various test scenarios
bugDetectionPotential: Medium - Would identify performance bottlenecks and resource leaks

title: Cross-browser Compatibility of Insights View in Functional Tests
description: Verify that the Insights view works correctly across all browsers supported by Playwright for functional tests.
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view renders correctly and provides consistent functionality across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge browsers.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. Playwright is configured to run tests on multiple browsers.
stepsToPerform:
1. Create a functional test that performs various UI interactions and assertions.
2. Configure the test to run with Insights view enabled on Chrome.
3. Run the same test with Insights view on Firefox.
4. Run the test with Insights view on Safari.
5. Run the test with Insights view on Edge.
6. For each browser, verify the Insights view functionality and appearance.
expectedResult:
1. Insights view loads and functions correctly on all tested browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
2. The layout, styling, and interactive elements of the Insights view are consistent across browsers.
3. All data is correctly captured and displayed in the Insights view regardless of the browser used for testing.
4. No browser-specific console errors or rendering issues are observed.
testEnvironment: Cross-browser testing environment with Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge
testData: Standard functional test that exercises common UI interactions
bugDetectionPotential: Medium - Would identify browser compatibility issues

title: Error Handling and Edge Cases for Insights View in Functional Tests
description: Verify that the Insights view properly handles errors and edge cases during functional test execution.
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view can handle and properly display various error conditions and edge cases that might occur during functional test execution.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. Access to create test scenarios that can trigger various error conditions.
stepsToPerform:
1. Create a functional test that deliberately fails an assertion.
2. Create a test that encounters a network error (e.g., timeout, 404).
3. Create a test that triggers JavaScript exceptions on the page.
4. Create a test with extremely large data output (e.g., large DOM, many network requests).
5. Create a test that abruptly terminates (force kill).
6. Run each test with Insights view enabled and observe how it handles each scenario.
expectedResult:
1. Failed assertions are clearly highlighted in the Insights view with relevant error details.
2. Network errors are properly captured and displayed with appropriate error information.
3. JavaScript exceptions are recorded and shown with stack traces in the Insights view.
4. Large data sets are handled efficiently without crashing or significantly slowing down the Insights view.
5. When tests are abruptly terminated, the Insights view either recovers gracefully or provides meaningful error information.
6. The Insights view itself doesn't crash or become unusable when tests encounter errors.
testEnvironment: Testing environment configured to allow error conditions
testData: Various test scenarios designed to trigger specific error conditions
bugDetectionPotential: High - Would identify issues with error handling and resilience

title: Configuration Options and Customization for Insights View in Playwright Tests
description: Verify that the Insights view can be configured with various options and customized for different functional test needs.
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view for Playwright functional tests supports various configuration options similar to those available in Unit, Integration, and API test implementations.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. Documentation of available configuration options from existing implementations.
3. Access to modify test configuration files.
stepsToPerform:
1. Create a functional test with default Insights view configuration.
2. Modify the configuration to change the display position of the Insights panel.
3. Configure the Insights view to show/hide specific sections (e.g., network requests, console logs).
4. Set custom screenshot capture timing/frequency in the configuration.
5. Configure custom data collection options.
6. Run the test with each configuration variation.
expectedResult:
1. Each configuration change is correctly applied to the Insights view.
2. The Insights panel position changes according to configuration.
3. Specific sections are shown/hidden as configured.
4. Screenshots are captured at the configured frequency/timing.
5. Custom data collection works as specified in the configuration.
6. Configuration changes don't negatively impact test execution or results reporting.
testEnvironment: Development environment with latest Playwright version
testData: Standard functional test with configuration variations
bugDetectionPotential: Medium - Would identify issues with configuration flexibility and customization options

title: Integration of Insights View with CI/CD Pipeline for Functional Tests
description: Verify that the Insights view for functional tests works correctly when executed within CI/CD pipeline environments.
testDescription: This test validates that the Insights view integration works properly in headless mode and can generate reports that are accessible and useful in CI/CD environments.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. CI/CD pipeline setup (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) for running Playwright tests.
3. Access to configure the CI/CD pipeline.
stepsToPerform:
1. Configure the CI/CD pipeline to run Playwright functional tests with Insights view enabled.
2. Set up the pipeline to run tests in headless mode.
3. Configure the pipeline to store Insights view reports as artifacts.
4. Trigger a pipeline run with a functional test suite.
5. Access and review the generated Insights reports from the pipeline artifacts.
expectedResult:
1. Tests execute successfully in the CI/CD environment with Insights view enabled.
2. Insights data is captured correctly even in headless mode.
3. Insights reports are properly generated and stored as pipeline artifacts.
4. The reports contain all expected data (screenshots, interactions, assertions, network activity).
5. Reports are accessible and readable after the pipeline run completes.
testEnvironment: CI/CD pipeline environment (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar)
testData: Standard functional test suite suitable for CI/CD execution
bugDetectionPotential: High - Would identify integration issues with CI/CD environments and headless execution

title: Data Filtering and Search Capabilities in Insights View
description: Verify that users can filter, search, and navigate through data in the Insights view for functional tests.
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view provides useful data filtering, search, and navigation capabilities to help users analyze functional test results efficiently.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. A functional test that generates substantial data (interactions, network requests, assertions).
stepsToPerform:
1. Run a complex functional test with the Insights view enabled.
2. After test completion, use the search functionality to find specific actions or assertions.
3. Apply filters to show only failed assertions, if any.
4. Filter to show only network requests with specific status codes.
5. Search for specific error messages or text content.
6. Use navigation controls to move between different sections of the Insights view.
7. Test any pagination or lazy-loading features when viewing large datasets.
expectedResult:
1. Search functionality correctly finds and highlights matching items in the Insights view.
2. Filters correctly limit the displayed data based on selected criteria.
3. Navigation controls allow efficient movement between different sections and timepoints.
4. Large datasets are handled efficiently with appropriate pagination or lazy-loading.
5. Filter and search states are preserved when switching between different sections.
6. UI remains responsive when interacting with large datasets.
testEnvironment: Test environment with production-like data volume
testData: Complex functional test that generates substantial data in Insights view
bugDetectionPotential: Medium - Would identify issues with data navigation and search functionality

title: Accessibility of Insights View in Playwright Functional Tests
description: Verify that the Insights view meets accessibility standards and can be used with assistive technologies.
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view implementation is accessible to all users, including those using screen readers and keyboard navigation.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. Access to accessibility testing tools and screen readers.
3. Knowledge of WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards.
stepsToPerform:
1. Run a functional test with Insights view enabled.
2. Test keyboard navigation through all interactive elements in the Insights view.
3. Verify that all interactive elements have appropriate focus indicators.
4. Use a screen reader to navigate through the Insights view.
5. Verify proper semantic HTML structure with accessibility testing tools.
6. Check color contrast ratios for text and interactive elements.
7. Verify that all images and visual elements have appropriate alt text or ARIA labels.
expectedResult:
1. All interactive elements in the Insights view are keyboard accessible.
2. Focus indicators are clearly visible when navigating with keyboard.
3. Screen readers can access and announce all relevant information in the Insights view.
4. HTML structure includes appropriate ARIA attributes and semantic elements.
5. Color contrast meets WCAG AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text).
6. No accessibility violations are detected by automated testing tools.
testEnvironment: Testing environment with accessibility testing tools and screen readers
testData: Standard functional test with Insights view enabled
bugDetectionPotential: Medium - Would identify accessibility barriers that might prevent some users from using the Insights view

title: Responsive Design of Insights View for Various Screen Sizes
description: Verify that the Insights view displays correctly and remains usable across various screen sizes and orientations.
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view for Playwright functional tests adapts appropriately to different viewport sizes, from large desktop monitors to smaller laptop screens.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. Capability to run tests with different viewport sizes or to resize the browser window.
3. Access to various physical devices or device emulation.
stepsToPerform:
1. Run a functional test with Insights view enabled on a large desktop monitor (e.g., 1920x1080).
2. Resize the browser window to a smaller laptop size (e.g., 1366x768).
3. Further resize to a very small window size.
4. If possible, test on an actual tablet device or using device emulation.
5. For each size, interact with all sections and features of the Insights view.
6. Check how the layout adjusts and if all features remain accessible.
expectedResult:
1. The Insights view layout adapts appropriately to different screen sizes.
2. No horizontal scrolling is required at standard viewport sizes.
3. All features and data remain accessible at all tested screen sizes.
4. Interactive elements remain usable and are not too small or overlapping.
5. Text remains readable at all viewport sizes.
6. Any responsive design breakpoints transition smoothly without layout issues.
testEnvironment: Various devices with different screen sizes or browser with resizing capability
testData: Standard functional test with comprehensive Insights data
bugDetectionPotential: Medium - Would identify layout issues that could impact usability on different devices or window sizes

title: Real-time Data Updates in Insights View During Test Execution
description: Verify that the Insights view updates in real-time as the functional test progresses through its steps.
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view provides real-time updates during test execution rather than only displaying results after test completion.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. A multi-step functional test is available for execution.
stepsToPerform:
1. Create a functional test with multiple steps including delays between actions.
2. Enable real-time updates in the Insights view configuration.
3. Run the test and observe the Insights view during execution.
4. Verify that each test step appears in the Insights view as it happens.
5. Check that screenshots are updated in real-time.
6. Monitor network request logging as requests occur.
7. Observe assertion results as they are evaluated.
expectedResult:
1. The Insights view updates progressively as each step of the test executes.
2. New screenshots appear in the Insights view shortly after each step completion.
3. Network requests are logged in real-time as they occur during the test.
4. Assertion results appear immediately after each assertion is evaluated.
5. The UI remains responsive during updates.
6. No significant test execution delay occurs due to real-time updates.
testEnvironment: Development environment with latest Playwright version
testData: Multi-step functional test with intentional delays between actions
bugDetectionPotential: High - Would identify issues with the real-time data collection and display mechanisms

title: Compatibility with Parallel Test Execution in Insights View
description: Verify that Insights view correctly handles and displays results when multiple functional tests are executed in parallel.
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view can properly manage and display data from multiple concurrent test executions without data mixing or corruption.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. Playwright is configured to support parallel test execution.
3. Multiple test files are available for parallel execution.
stepsToPerform:
1. Configure Playwright to run multiple test files in parallel with Insights view enabled.
2. Set up unique identifiers for each parallel test.
3. Execute at least 5 different functional tests simultaneously.
4. Observe how the Insights view manages the parallel test data.
5. Switch between different test results in the Insights view if a selection mechanism exists.
6. Verify data separation between parallel test executions.
expectedResult:
1. Each parallel test execution has its own separate Insights view instance or tab.
2. Test data from different parallel executions is not mixed or corrupted.
3. The Insights view provides a mechanism to select and view results from specific test executions.
4. Performance remains stable when multiple Insights view instances are active.
5. All data (screenshots, logs, assertions) is correctly associated with its respective test execution.
6. The UI provides clear indication of which test execution is currently being viewed.
testEnvironment: Testing environment configured for parallel test execution
testData: Multiple independent functional test files suitable for parallel execution
bugDetectionPotential: High - Would identify issues with data isolation and management in parallel execution scenarios

title: Insights View Report Export and Sharing Capabilities
description: Verify that Insights view data can be exported in various formats and shared with stakeholders.
testDescription: This test ensures that users can export Insights view data in different formats (HTML, PDF, JSON) and that the exports contain all relevant test information.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. A functional test has been executed with comprehensive test data in the Insights view.
stepsToPerform:
1. Run a functional test that generates comprehensive data in the Insights view.
2. Locate and use the export functionality in the Insights view UI.
3. Export the test results in HTML format.
4. Export the test results in PDF format if supported.
5. Export the test results in JSON or other machine-readable format if supported.
6. Verify each exported file by opening it and checking content completeness.
7. Test any sharing mechanisms (email, link generation) if implemented.
expectedResult:
1. Export options are available and accessible in the Insights view UI.
2. HTML exports contain all test data including screenshots, logs, and assertion results.
3. PDF exports are properly formatted and include all critical test information.
4. JSON/machine-readable exports contain all raw test data in a structured format.
5. Exported files correctly represent the visual state of the Insights view.
6. Any sharing mechanisms function properly, generating valid links or emails.
7. Exported reports maintain visual fidelity and readability.
testEnvironment: Testing environment with export capabilities enabled
testData: Comprehensive functional test that generates diverse data types in the Insights view
bugDetectionPotential: Medium - Would identify issues with data export and sharing mechanisms

title: Visual Comparison Capabilities in Insights View
description: Verify that the Insights view provides visual comparison tools for screenshots captured during functional test execution.
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view includes capabilities to visually compare screenshots from different test runs or against baseline images.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. Visual comparison functionality is implemented in the Insights view.
3. Baseline screenshots are available or can be established.
stepsToPerform:
1. Execute a functional test that captures multiple screenshots with Insights view enabled.
2. Save the current test run screenshots as baseline images.
3. Make visual changes to the application under test.
4. Re-run the same functional test to capture new screenshots.
5. Use the visual comparison features in the Insights view to compare new screenshots with baseline.
6. Test any highlighting of visual differences.
7. Verify difference threshold settings if available.
8. Check export options for visual comparison results.
expectedResult:
1. The Insights view provides functionality to compare screenshots visually.
2. Visual differences between baseline and current screenshots are highlighted or indicated clearly.
3. The comparison tool provides options to adjust sensitivity/threshold for detecting differences.
4. Users can zoom in and navigate within the comparison view to examine details.
5. Comparison results can be exported or shared if needed.
6. The comparison tool handles various types of visual changes (text, layout, color, etc.).
7. False positives are minimized with appropriate threshold settings.
testEnvironment: Testing environment with visual comparison capabilities
testData: Functional test with visual elements that can be modified between runs
bugDetectionPotential: High - Would identify regression issues in the UI that might be missed by functional assertions alone

title: Persistency and History of Insights View Data Across Test Runs
description: Verify that historical test execution data is preserved and can be accessed across multiple test runs.
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view maintains a history of previous test executions and allows users to browse and compare results from multiple runs over time.
prerequisites:
1. Insights view is successfully integrated with Playwright functional tests.
2. Data persistence mechanism is implemented for Insights view.
3. Storage location for historical test data is configured.
stepsToPerform:
1. Run a functional test with Insights view enabled and verify the initial data capture.
2. Close the browser or test runner completely.
3. Re-open the test environment and access the Insights view history section.
4. Locate and open the previously executed test results.
5. Run the same test again with some variation in the test data or conditions.
6. Access the history to view both test executions.
7. Use any comparison features to compare the two test runs.
8. Test any data retention policy settings if implemented.
expectedResult:
1. Test execution history is persistent and available after reopening the test environment.
2. Previous test runs are properly cataloged with timestamps and test identifiers.
3. All data from previous test executions (screenshots, logs, assertions) is preserved and accessible.
4. The history view provides adequate filtering and search capabilities to find specific test runs.
5. Comparison features correctly highlight differences between test runs.
6. Data retention policies (if implemented) function as expected, archiving or removing old test data according to configuration.
testEnvironment: Testing environment with data persistence enabled
testData: Same functional test executed multiple times with variations
bugDetectionPotential: Medium - Would identify issues with data persistence and historical comparisons
